description: Declare that two accounts are the same person, for your organization only: fold account `id` into person `into`. Their mentions, tags and notes combine; the folded account shows under the person's platforms. With groupId the merge holds in that keyword group only.

groupId.description: Scope to one keyword group (grp_...): only people who mentioned that group's keywords, with that group's own tags, notes, mute, merges, activities and segments. Omit for the whole workspace.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

into.description: The person to fold it into (aut_...)

name: merge_people
title: Merge people
